name: Flow
category_description: App node - connects to an external service API
description: Use the Flow node to automate work in Flow, and integrate Flow with other applications. n8n has built-in support for a wide range of Flow features, including creating, updating, and getting tasks
subtitle: ={{$parameter["operation"] + ": " + $parameter["resource"]}}

options.name: Task
options.description: Tasks are units of work that can be private or assigned to a list. Through this endpoint, you can manipulate your tasks in Flow, including creating new ones.

options.name: Create
options.description: Create a new task

options.name: Update
options.description: Update a task

options.name: Get
options.description: Get a task

options.name: Get Many
options.description: Get many tasks

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Create resources under the given workspace

options.name: ownerid
options.description: The ID of the account to whom this task will be assigned

options.name: listID
options.description: Put the new task in a list ("project"). Omit this param to have the task be private.

options.name: startsOn
options.description: The date on which the task should start

options.name: dueOn
options.description: The date on which the task should be due

options.name: mirrorParentSubscribers
options.description: Whether this task will be a subtask, and this is true, the parent tasks's subscribers will be mirrored to this one

options.name: mirrorParentTags
options.description: Whether this task will be a subtask, and this is true, the parent tasks's tags will be mirrored to this one

options.name: noteContent
options.description: Provide the content for the task's note

options.name: noteMimeType
options.description: Identify which markup language is used to format the given note

options.name: parentId
options.description: If provided, this task will become a subtask of the given task

options.name: positionList
options.description: Determines the sort order when showing tasks in, or grouped by, a list

options.name: positionUpcoming
options.description: Determines the sort order when showing tasks grouped by their due_date

options.name: position
options.description: Determines the sort order of tasks

options.name: sectionId
options.description: Specify which section under which to create this task

options.name: tags
options.description: A list of tag names to apply to the new task separated by a comma (,)
